
<html lang="en" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>GhostMC SMP — Official Ranks & Store</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com">
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Orbitron:wght@600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root,
        body[data-theme="phantom"] {
            --bg-base: #05030f;
            --bg-surface: rgba(15, 10, 34, 0.82);
            --bg-card: rgba(22, 14, 48, 0.85);
            --accent-primary: #a855f7;
            --accent-secondary: #ec4899;
            --accent-tertiary: #f59e0b;
            --glow-rgba: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
            --glow-secondary: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.32);
            --grid-line: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08);
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--bg-base);
            color: #f1f5f9;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        .font-display {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
        }
        .bg-grid-pattern {
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(circle at 15% 15%, var(--glow-rgba) 0%, transparent 40%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 85% 25%, var(--glow-secondary) 0%, transparent 42%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 85%, var(--glow-rgba) 0%, transparent 45%),
                linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 36px 36px, 36px 36px;
            background-attachment: fixed;
        }
        .neon-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px -10px var(--glow-rgba), 0 0 25px var(--glow-secondary), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        }
        .neon-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #d8b4fe 30%, var(--accent-primary) 65%, var(--accent-secondary) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px var(--glow-rgba));
        }
        .theme-card-glass {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.28);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        }
        .theme-btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7, #ec4899);
            color: #ffffff !important;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px -4px var(--glow-rgba);
        }
        .theme-btn-primary:hover {
            filter: brightness(1.12);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }
        .card-hover {
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        }
        .card-hover:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.015);
            box-shadow: 0 22px 45px -12px var(--glow-rgba), 0 0 25px var(--glow-secondary), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
        }
        @keyframes floatSlow {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(1deg); }
        }
        .animate-float {
            animation: floatSlow 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes borderPulse {
            0%, 100% { border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.7); }
            50% { border-color: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.7); }
        }
        .theme-border-pulse {
            animation: borderPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        #upi-qr-container img, #upi-qr-container canvas {
            margin: 0 auto;
            border-radius: 0.75rem;
        }
        @keyframes shake {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
            15%, 45%, 75% { transform: translateX(-6px); }
            30%, 60%, 90% { transform: translateX(6px); }
        }
        .animate-shake {
            animation: shake 0.45s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both;
        }
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.98); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }
        .animate-fadeInUp {
            animation: fadeInUp 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
        }
        @keyframes loaderGlow {
            0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6)); }
            50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.8)); }
        }
        .animate-loader-glow {
            animation: loaderGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes textMorph {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.95); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }
        .animate-text-morph {
            animation: textMorph 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
        }
        /* Professional Dual-Phase Kinetic Greeting Animations */
        @keyframes greetingExit {
            0% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
                filter: blur(0px);
                letter-spacing: normal;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-16px) scale(0.94);
                filter: blur(8px);
                letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            }
        }
        @keyframes greetingEnter {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(18px) scale(1.06);
                filter: blur(8px);
                letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            }
            60% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(-2px) scale(0.99);
                filter: blur(0px);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
                filter: blur(0px);
                letter-spacing: normal;
            }
        }
        @keyframes hudPulse {
            0%, 100% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 35px -5px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35), inset 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
                border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35);
            }
            50% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 55px 0px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.45), inset 0 0 30px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.15);
                border-color: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.55);
            }
        }
        @keyframes scanlineSweep {
            0% { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; }
            50% { opacity: 0.9; }
            100% { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; }
        }
        .greeting-hud-pod {
            animation: hudPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .greeting-anim-exit {
            animation: greetingExit 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) forwards;
        }
        .greeting-anim-enter {
            animation: greetingEnter 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
        }
        /* Realistic Organic Fire Animations */
        @keyframes flameTongueSway1 {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1) scaleX(1) translateX(0) skewX(0deg); opacity: 0.9; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.7)); }
            28% { transform: scaleY(1.16) scaleX(0.96) translateX(-8px) skewX(-2.5deg); opacity: 0.98; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.85)); }
            54% { transform: scaleY(0.88) scaleX(1.03) translateX(6px) skewX(2deg); opacity: 0.82; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.6)); }
            78% { transform: scaleY(1.22) scaleX(0.94) translateX(-4px) skewX(-1.5deg); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.9)); }
        }
        @keyframes flameTongueSway2 {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1.04) scaleX(0.97) translateX(0) skewX(1deg); opacity: 0.95; }
            33% { transform: scaleY(0.89) scaleX(1.04) translateX(10px) skewX(2.5deg); opacity: 0.85; }
            66% { transform: scaleY(1.24) scaleX(0.93) translateX(-9px) skewX(-2deg); opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes flameTongueCore {
            0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1) translateY(0) scaleX(1); opacity: 0.95; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.9)); }
            20% { transform: scaleY(1.18) translateY(-2px) scaleX(0.96) skewX(1.5deg); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)); }
            50% { transform: scaleY(0.92) translateY(1px) scaleX(1.03) skewX(-1.2deg); opacity: 0.88; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(253, 224, 71, 0.8)); }
            80% { transform: scaleY(1.25) translateY(-3px) scaleX(0.94) skewX(1deg); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)); }
        }
        @keyframes heatGlowPulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.65; transform: scaleY(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scaleY(1.15); }
        }
        @keyframes realisticEmberRise {
            0% { transform: translateY(0) translateX(0) scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
            15% { opacity: 1; }
            65% { opacity: 0.9; }
            100% { transform: translateY(-56px) translateX(var(--ember-shift, 14px)) scale(1.15); opacity: 0; }
        }
        .flame-anim-outer {
            animation: flameTongueSway1 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
            transform-origin: bottom center;
        }
        .flame-anim-mid {
            animation: flameTongueSway2 1.85s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
            transform-origin: bottom center;
        }
        .flame-anim-core {
            animation: flameTongueCore 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95) infinite;
            transform-origin: bottom center;
        }
        .heat-glow-pulse {
            animation: heatGlowPulse 2.1s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .ember-realistic-1 { animation: realisticEmberRise 2.1s ease-out infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-2 { animation: realisticEmberRise 1.75s ease-out 0.3s infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-3 { animation: realisticEmberRise 2.4s ease-out 0.7s infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-4 { animation: realisticEmberRise 1.9s ease-out 1.1s infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-5 { animation: realisticEmberRise 2.25s ease-out 1.5s infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-6 { animation: realisticEmberRise 1.65s ease-out 0.5s infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-7 { animation: realisticEmberRise 2.5s ease-out 0.9s infinite; }
        .ember-realistic-8 { animation: realisticEmberRise 2.0s ease-out 1.3s infinite; }

        /* View Mode Switcher Styles (Desktop vs Mobile Viewport Controls) */
        .view-toggle-btn {
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] .desktop-nav-bar {
            display: flex !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #mobile-menu-btn {
            display: none !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #mobile-menu {
            display: none !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #hero-heading {
            font-size: 3.5rem !important;
            line-height: 1.05 !important;
        }
        @media (min-width: 640px) {
            body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #hero-heading {
                font-size: 4.5rem !important;
            }
        }
        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
            body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #hero-heading {
                font-size: 5.25rem !important;
            }
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #ranks-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)) !important;
        }
        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
            body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #ranks-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
            }
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #connect-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #staff-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="desktop"] #privacy-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
        }

        /* Mobile View Mode Specific Adjustments */
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] .desktop-nav-bar {
            display: none !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] #mobile-menu-btn {
            display: block !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] #hero-heading {
            font-size: 2.25rem !important;
            line-height: 2.5rem !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] #ranks-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] #connect-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] #staff-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] #privacy-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        }
        body[data-view-mode="mobile"] .view-mode-container {
            max-width: 520px !important;
            margin-left: auto !important;
            margin-right: auto !important;
            box-shadow: 0 0 60px -10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4) !important;
            border-left: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2) !important;
            border-right: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2) !important;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #05030f;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #a855f7;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body data-theme="phantom" class="bg-grid-pattern min-h-screen flex flex-col selection:bg-purple-600 selection:text-white relative">

    <!-- Advanced Cyber Loading Screen -->
    <div id="cyber-loader" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-[#05030f] transition-all duration-700 ease-in-out select-none p-4 overflow-hidden">
        <!-- Background Grid & Glowing Hologram Effects -->
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-grid-pattern opacity-60 pointer-events-none"></div>
        <div class="absolute w-[500px] h-[500px] rounded-full bg-purple-600/15 blur-[120px] animate-pulse pointer-events-none"></div>
        <div class="absolute w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-purple-600/15 blur-[100px] pointer-events-none" style="animation: pulse 4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;"></div>

        <!-- Top-Left Corner: Desktop / Mobile Viewport Switcher in Loading Screen with Labels Above Each Option -->
        <div id="loader-view-mode-container" class="absolute top-3 sm:top-5 left-3 sm:left-5 z-30 flex items-center gap-2.5 select-none pointer-events-auto bg-slate-950/80 p-2 sm:p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-purple-500/40 backdrop-blur-md shadow-lg shadow-purple-950/50">
            <!-- Desktop Option Column (Desktop label above, Desktop button below) -->
            <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                <span id="loader-label-desktop" class="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-300">Desktop</span>
                <button id="loader-view-desktop-btn" type="button" aria-label="Desktop View" class="view-toggle-btn active px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-md cursor-pointer">
                    <span class="text-xs">🖥️</span>
                    <span class="text-xs">Desktop</span>
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Mobile Option Column (Mobile label above, Mobile button below) -->
            <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                <span id="loader-label-mobile" class="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Mobile</span>
                <button id="loader-view-mobile-btn" type="button" aria-label="Mobile View" class="view-toggle-btn px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-purple-500/30 text-slate-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
                    <span class="text-xs">📱</span>
                    <span class="text-xs">Mobile</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>



        <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center px-4 max-w-2xl w-full">
            <!-- Glowing GhostMC Logo with HUD Target Rings -->
            <div class="relative mb-8">
                <!-- Rotating Tech Dashed Ring -->
                <div class="absolute -inset-5 rounded-full border-2 border-cyan-500/30 border-dashed animate-[spin_20s_linear_infinite] pointer-events-none" style="animation-duration: 14s;"></div>
                <div class="absolute -inset-2.5 rounded-full border border-purple-500/40 animate-pulse pointer-events-none"></div>
                <!-- Logo -->
                <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="GhostMC Logo" class="w-24 h-24 sm:w-28 sm:h-28 object-contain animate-loader-glow relative z-10">
                <div class="absolute -bottom-2 -right-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white text-[10px] font-black uppercase font-mono shadow-md z-20">
                    SMP
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Greeting Card: Holographic Cyber Pod (Centered, Professional HUD Aesthetic) -->
            <div id="loader-greeting-card" class="relative w-full max-w-xl mx-auto px-6 py-6 sm:px-10 sm:py-7 rounded-3xl bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-xl border border-purple-500/40 shadow-[0_0_40px_-5px_rgba(168,85,247,0.4)] my-3 transition-all duration-500 overflow-hidden greeting-hud-pod">
                <!-- HUD Corner Tech Brackets -->
                <div class="absolute top-2 left-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-purple-400/70 rounded-tl pointer-events-none"></div>
                <div class="absolute top-2 right-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 border-t-2 border-r-2 border-purple-400/70 rounded-tr pointer-events-none"></div>
                <div class="absolute bottom-2 left-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 border-b-2 border-l-2 border-purple-400/70 rounded-bl pointer-events-none"></div>
                <div class="absolute bottom-2 right-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-purple-400/70 rounded-br pointer-events-none"></div>

                <!-- Top Language Pill Badge -->
                <div class="flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
                    <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-purple-950/80 border border-purple-500/40 shadow-inner">
                        <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
                        <span id="loader-lang-badge" class="text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-purple-200 transition-all duration-300">English • Hello</span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Main Greeting Word (Huge & Centered with Kinetic Morph) -->
                <div class="min-h-[72px] sm:min-h-[92px] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                    <div id="loader-greeting-text" class="font-sans text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-wide text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-200 via-pink-300 to-amber-200 neon-text text-center break-words max-w-full leading-none transition-all greeting-anim-enter">
                        Hello
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Glowing Scanning Pulse Line -->
                <div class="relative w-40 sm:w-56 h-[2px] mx-auto my-3 overflow-hidden bg-purple-950/60 rounded-full">
                    <div class="absolute inset-y-0 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-pink-400 to-transparent animate-[scanlineSweep_2s_ease-in-out_infinite]"></div>
                </div>

                <!-- Subtext Translation & Welcome Message -->
                <div id="loader-subtext" class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider sm:tracking-widest text-purple-300/90 transition-all duration-300 text-center max-w-full">
                    Welcome to GhostMC SMP
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Percentage Counter Removed from Display (Hidden element retained for background tick safety & check compatibility) -->
            <span id="loader-percent" class="hidden" aria-hidden="true">0%</span>

            <!-- Server Connection Indicator -->
            <div class="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-purple-500/30 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-300 shadow-md">
                <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
                <span>basic.vitalcloud.in:19153</span>
            </div>

        </div>
        <!-- Realistic Contained Bottom Fire Edge (Organic Multi-Layered Flame Tongues & Embers) -->
        <div class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 sm:h-20 pointer-events-none z-10 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end">
            <!-- Layer 0: Ground Heat Shimmer & Ambient Radial Flame Glow -->
            <div class="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-16 bg-gradient-to-t from-red-600/40 via-orange-500/25 to-transparent blur-md heat-glow-pulse pointer-events-none"></div>

            <!-- Layer 1: Floating Sparks & Fiery Embers with Organic Drift -->
            <div class="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-2 h-16 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
                <div class="absolute left-[8%] bottom-0 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-200 shadow-[0_0_10px_#fef08a] ember-realistic-1" style="--ember-shift: 12px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[19%] bottom-0 w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_7px_#f59e0b] ember-realistic-2" style="--ember-shift: -9px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[31%] bottom-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#ea580c] ember-realistic-3" style="--ember-shift: 15px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[44%] bottom-0 w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-yellow-300 shadow-[0_0_8px_#fde047] ember-realistic-4" style="--ember-shift: -11px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[56%] bottom-0 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-300 shadow-[0_0_9px_#f59e0b] ember-realistic-5" style="--ember-shift: 8px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[68%] bottom-0 w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-orange-300 shadow-[0_0_7px_#f97316] ember-realistic-6" style="--ember-shift: -14px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[79%] bottom-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-yellow-200 shadow-[0_0_10px_#fef08a] ember-realistic-7" style="--ember-shift: 10px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[89%] bottom-0 w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_#d97706] ember-realistic-8" style="--ember-shift: -8px;"></div>
                <div class="absolute left-[96%] bottom-0 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-400 shadow-[0_0_9px_#ea580c] ember-realistic-2" style="--ember-shift: 12px;"></div>
            </div>

            <!-- Layer 2: Deep Crimson / Blood-Orange Licking Flame Tongues (Back Mantle) -->
            <svg class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-[116%] -ml-[8%] h-14 sm:h-18 flame-anim-outer opacity-75" viewBox="0 0 1200 90" preserveAspectRatio="none">
                <defs>

                    </p>

                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">

                    </div>

    <section id="faq" class="py-16 sm:py-20 bg-slate-950/70 relative border-t border-purple-500/15">
        <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
            <div class="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-14">
                <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-900/40 border border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400"></span>
                    Help &amp; Answers
                </div>
                <h2 class="font-display font-extrabold text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white tracking-tight">
                    Frequently Asked <span class="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-purple-400 to-pink-400">Questions</span>
                </h2>
                <p class="text-slate-400 text-sm sm:text-base mt-2">
                    Everything you need to know about joining, playing, and purchasing ranks on GhostMC SMP.
                </p>
            </div>

            <div class="space-y-4">
                <!-- FAQ Item 1 -->
                <div class="faq-accordion-item rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-purple-500/25 overflow-hidden transition-all">
                    <button type="button" class="faq-question-btn w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">
                        <span>📱 How do I connect to GhostMC from Minecraft Bedrock (Mobile / PE)?</span>
                        <svg class="faq-chevron w-5 h-5 text-purple-400 transition-transform duration-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div class="faq-answer px-6 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-800/60 leading-relaxed hidden">
                        Open Minecraft on your smartphone or tablet, tap <strong class="text-slate-200">Play</strong> &gt; <strong class="text-slate-200">Servers</strong> &gt; <strong class="text-slate-200">Add Server</strong>. Enter Server Address: <code class="text-cyan-300">basic.vitalcloud.in</code> and Port: <code class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">19153</code>. Then tap Save and Join!
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- FAQ Item 2 -->
                <div class="faq-accordion-item rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-purple-500/25 overflow-hidden transition-all">
                    <button type="button" class="faq-question-btn w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">
                        <span>🎮 What Minecraft versions are supported on GhostMC SMP?</span>
                        <svg class="faq-chevron w-5 h-5 text-purple-400 transition-transform duration-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div class="faq-answer px-6 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-800/60 leading-relaxed hidden">
                        GhostMC SMP supports all versions from <strong class="text-slate-200">Minecraft Java 1.16 through 1.20.4+</strong> and the latest Bedrock updates. For optimal visuals and PVP response, we recommend version 1.20.2 or 1.20.4.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- FAQ Item 3 -->
                <div class="faq-accordion-item rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-purple-500/25 overflow-hidden transition-all">
                    <button type="button" class="faq-question-btn w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">
                        <span>💎 Is GhostMC SMP Pay-to-Win (P2W)?</span>
                        <svg class="faq-chevron w-5 h-5 text-purple-400 transition-transform duration-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div class="faq-answer px-6 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-800/60 leading-relaxed hidden">
                        <strong class="text-white">Absolutely not!</strong> All store ranks provide quality-of-life benefits (such as extra <code class="text-purple-300">/sethome</code> points, colorful chat prefixes, cosmetic fly in lobby, and convenience kits). All in-game gear and enchantments can be earned through gameplay.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- FAQ Item 4 -->
                <div class="faq-accordion-item rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-purple-500/25 overflow-hidden transition-all">
                    <button type="button" class="faq-question-btn w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">
                        <span>💳 How do I claim my rank after paying via UPI?</span>
                        <svg class="faq-chevron w-5 h-5 text-purple-400 transition-transform duration-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div class="faq-answer px-6 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-800/60 leading-relaxed hidden">
                        1. Pay to UPI ID <code class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">ghostmc.fund@axl</code> (or scan the QR in checkout modal).<br>
                        2. Take a screenshot of the completed payment with the UTR / Ref number.<br>
                        3. Click <a href="https://discord.gg/H4p2TuNCA" target="_blank" class="text-cyan-400 underline">Join Discord</a> and open a <strong class="text-white">#ticket-claim</strong>.<br>
                        4. Provide your Minecraft username and screenshot. Owner Devesh will activate your rank within minutes!
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- FAQ Item 5 -->
                <div class="faq-accordion-item rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-purple-500/25 overflow-hidden transition-all">
                    <button type="button" class="faq-question-btn w-full px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-left text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">
                        <span>🚨 How do I report a hacker, rule-breaker, or server bug?</span>
                        <svg class="faq-chevron w-5 h-5 text-purple-400 transition-transform duration-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <div class="faq-answer px-6 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-800/60 leading-relaxed hidden">
                        Use the in-game <code class="text-purple-300">/report &lt;player&gt; &lt;reason&gt;</code> command, submit feedback through the on-site <a href="#feedback" class="text-purple-400 underline">Feedback Portal</a>, or open an urgent ticket in our official <a href="https://discord.gg/H4p2TuNCA" target="_blank" class="text-indigo-400 underline">Discord Server</a>.
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

            <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">

                    <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-2">
                        GhostMC SMP transparent rules regarding player data, UPI payments, rank claiming, and server usage.
                    </p>

                <div id="privacy-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-purple-500/20 space-y-2">
                        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-purple-400">1. Player Information &amp; Privacy</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                            GhostMC SMP collects only your <strong>Minecraft Username (IGN)</strong>, <strong>Game Edition (Java/Bedrock)</strong>, and optional <strong>UPI Transaction Reference / Screenshot</strong> solely for verifying store purchases and delivering your in-game Rank and Kit on <span class="font-mono text-white">basic.vitalcloud.in:19153</span>. We never sell or share your personal information.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-purple-500/20 space-y-2">
                        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-emerald-400">2. UPI Payments &amp; Security</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                            All store payments are processed directly via your trusted UPI app (GPay or PhonePe) to our official verified UPI ID <span class="font-mono text-emerald-300 font-semibold">ghostmc.fund@axl</span>. Our website does not store bank details, UPI PIN, or card credentials.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-purple-500/20 space-y-2">
                        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-amber-400">3. Rank &amp; Kit Claim Policy</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                            After completing a rank purchase, players must take a <strong>screenshot of the successful payment transaction</strong>, join the official <a href="https://discord.gg/H4p2TuNCA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-indigo-400 underline font-semibold">GhostMC Discord Server</a>, create a support ticket, and share the screenshot with their Minecraft IGN for prompt delivery by <strong>Owner Devesh</strong> or <strong>2nd Owner Total</strong>.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-purple-500/20 space-y-2">
                        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-pink-400">4. Refund Policy &amp; Mojang Disclaimer</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                            All store purchases support hosting and upkeep of GhostMC SMP and are final once delivered in-game. <em>GhostMC SMP is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang Synergies AB or Microsoft.</em>

    <script>
        const MERCHANT_UPI = 'ghostmc.fund@axl';
        const MERCHANT_NAME = 'GhostMC SMP';

        const RANKS_DATA = [
            {
                id: 'bronze',
                number: 1,
                name: 'Bronze Rank',
                kit: 'Novice Kit',
                price: 30,
                tier: 'budget',
                badge: 'Starter Tier',

                textAccent: 'text-amber-400',
                perks: ['Kit Included: Novice Kit', '[Bronze] Chat Prefix', 'Set up to 2 Homes', 'Support GhostMC SMP']
            },
            {
                id: 'silver',
                number: 2,
                name: 'Silver Rank',
                kit: 'Warrior Kit',
                price: 50,
                tier: 'budget',
                badge: 'Popular Starter',
                accent: 'from-slate-600/30 to-slate-800/30 border-slate-400/40',
                btnClass: 'bg-slate-200 hover:bg-white text-slate-950',
                textAccent: 'text-slate-200',
                perks: ['Kit Included: Warrior Kit', '[Silver] Chat Prefix', 'Set up to 3 Homes', 'Access to /workbench']
            },
            {
                id: 'gold',
                number: 3,
                name: 'Gold Rank',
                kit: 'Elite Kit',
                price: 100,
                tier: 'budget',
                badge: 'Value Pick',
                accent: 'from-yellow-500/25 to-amber-700/20 border-yellow-400/50',
                btnClass: 'bg-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-300 text-slate-950',
                textAccent: 'text-yellow-300',
                perks: ['Kit Included: Elite Kit', '[Gold] Chat Prefix', 'Set up to 5 Homes', 'Access to /enderchest']
            },
            {
                id: 'platinum',
                number: 4,
                name: 'Platinum Rank',
                kit: 'Legend Kit',
                price: 140,
                tier: 'premium',
                badge: 'Legend Tier',
                accent: 'from-purple-500/25 to-pink-800/20 border-purple-400/50',
                btnClass: 'bg-purple-400 hover:bg-purple-300 text-slate-950',
                textAccent: 'text-purple-300',
                perks: ['Kit Included: Legend Kit', '[Platinum] Chat Prefix', 'Set up to 7 Homes', 'Priority Server Queue']
            },
            {
                id: 'diamond',
                number: 5,
                name: 'Diamond Rank',
                kit: 'God Kit',
                price: 200,
                tier: 'premium',
                badge: 'Best Seller',
                accent: 'from-blue-500/30 to-indigo-900/30 border-blue-400/60',
                btnClass: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 to-pink-500 hover:from-purple-300 hover:to-pink-400 text-white',
                textAccent: 'text-purple-300',
                perks: ['Kit Included: God Kit', '[Diamond] Glowing Prefix', 'Set up to 10 Homes', 'Keep XP & Special Perks']
            },
            {
                id: 'royal',
                number: 6,
                name: 'Royal Rank',
                kit: 'Endless Kit',
                price: 500,
                tier: 'premium',
                badge: '👑 Ultimate Rank',
                accent: 'from-purple-600/35 via-fuchsia-600/20 to-amber-500/20 border-fuchsia-400/60',
                btnClass: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-400 via-purple-400 to-amber-300 hover:opacity-95 text-slate-950',
                textAccent: 'text-fuchsia-300',
                perks: ['Kit Included: Endless Kit', '👑 [Royal] Custom Prefix', 'Unlimited /sethome Access', 'All Exclusive VIP Commands']
            }
        ];

        let cart = [];
        let activeFilter = 'all';
        let selectedPayment = 'GPay (Google Pay)';

        function buildUpiUri(amount, note) {
            const params = [
                `pa=${encodeURIComponent(MERCHANT_UPI)}`,
                `pn=${encodeURIComponent(MERCHANT_NAME)}`,
                `am=${encodeURIComponent(String(amount))}`,
                `cu=INR`,
                `tn=${encodeURIComponent(note)}`
            ];
            return `upi://pay?${params.join('&')}`;
        }

        function copyToClipboard(text, label) {
            const done = () => showToast(`Copied ${label}: ${text}`);
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text, done));
            } else {
                fallbackCopy(text, done);
            }
        }

        function fallbackCopy(text, callback) {
            const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.position = 'fixed';
            ta.style.opacity = '0';
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.select();
            try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
            document.body.removeChild(ta);
            callback();
        }

        function showToast(message) {
            const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/95 border border-purple-400/50 text-purple-200 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 pointer-events-auto transition-all';
            toast.innerHTML = `<span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span><span>${message}</span>`;
            container.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
            }, 2600);
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
            }[m]));
        }

        function renderRanks() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('ranks-grid');
            const filtered = activeFilter === 'all'
                ? RANKS_DATA
                : RANKS_DATA.filter(r => r.tier === activeFilter);

            grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(rank => {
                const inCart = cart.some(item => item.id === rank.id);
                return `
                <div class="card-hover rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-b ${rank.accent} border-2 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div class="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-28 h-28 rounded-full bg-white/5 blur-2xl pointer-events-none"></div>
                    <div>
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4">
                            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/10 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${rank.textAccent}">
                                #${rank.number} • ${rank.badge}
                            </span>
                            <span class="font-display text-2xl font-black text-white bg-slate-950/80 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                                ₹${rank.price}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <h3 class="font-display text-2xl font-extrabold text-white">${rank.name}</h3>
                        <div class="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/70 border border-white/10 text-xs font-semibold ${rank.textAccent}">
                            <span>🎒 Kit Included: <strong>${rank.kit}</strong></span>
                        </div>

                        <ul class="mt-5 space-y-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300">
                            ${rank.perks.map(p => `
                                <li class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">✓</span>
                                    <span>${p}</span>
                                </li>
                            `).join('')}
                        </ul>
                    </div>

                    <div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 space-y-3">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300">
                            <span class="text-slate-400 font-mono text-[11px]">UPI: ${MERCHANT_UPI}</span>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white text-slate-900 font-extrabold text-[11px] shadow-sm">GPay</span>
                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-600 text-white font-extrabold text-[11px] shadow-sm">PhonePe</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/75 border border-amber-400/25 text-[11px] text-slate-300 leading-snug">
                            📸 <strong class="text-amber-300">Buy Note:</strong> After payment, take a screenshot of the transaction, go to our <a href="https://discord.gg/H4p2TuNCA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-indigo-300 underline font-semibold">Discord Server</a>, create a ticket, and claim your rank.
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                            <button type="button" data-buy-id="${rank.id}" class="buy-now-btn flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg transition-all ${rank.btnClass}">
                                Buy via UPI • ₹${rank.price}
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" data-cart-id="${rank.id}" class="toggle-cart-btn px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-slate-950/80 hover:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-all">
                                ${inCart ? '✓ In Cart' : '+ Cart'}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            grid.querySelectorAll('.buy-now-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-buy-id');
                    const rank = RANKS_DATA.find(r => r.id === id);
                    if (rank) {
                        if (!cart.some(i => i.id === rank.id)) {
                            cart = [rank];
                        }
                        updateCartUI();
                    }
                    openCheckoutModal();
                });
            });

            grid.querySelectorAll('.toggle-cart-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-cart-id');
                    const rank = RANKS_DATA.find(r => r.id === id);
                    if (!rank) return;
                    const exists = cart.some(i => i.id === rank.id);
                    if (exists) {
                        cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== rank.id);
                        showToast(`Removed ${rank.name} from cart`);
                    } else {
                        cart.push(rank);
                        showToast(`Added ${rank.name} (₹${rank.price}) to cart`);
                    }
                    updateCartUI();
                });
            });
        }

        function updateCartUI() {
            const badge = document.getElementById('cart-badge');
            badge.textContent = String(cart.length);
            renderRanks();
            renderModalCart();
        }

        function updateUpiPaymentWidgets() {
            const total = cart.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.price, 0);
            const username = document.getElementById('mc-username').value.trim() || 'Player';
            const rankNames = cart.map(i => i.name).join(', ') || 'GhostMC Rank';
            const note = `${rankNames} (${username})`;
            const upiUri = buildUpiUri(total > 0 ? total : 30, note);

            const payLink = document.getElementById('direct-upi-pay-link');
            payLink.setAttribute('href', upiUri);
            payLink.innerHTML = total > 0
                ? `<span>⚡ Pay ₹${total} via ${selectedPayment.split(' ')[0]}</span>`
                : `<span>⚡ Pay via UPI App</span>`;

            const qrContainer = document.getElementById('upi-qr-container');
            qrContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (typeof QRCode !== 'undefined') {
                new QRCode(qrContainer, {
                    text: upiUri,
                    width: 120,
                    height: 120,
                    colorDark: '#070b14',
                    colorLight: '#ffffff',
                    correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M
                });
            } else {
                qrContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-[11px] text-slate-900 font-mono text-center p-2 break-all">${MERCHANT_UPI}<br><strong>₹${total}</strong></div>`;
            }
        }

        function renderModalCart() {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('modal-cart-items');
            const totalEl = document.getElementById('modal-total-price');

            if (cart.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                        Your cart is empty. Select a rank from the store to continue!
                    </div>
                `;
                totalEl.textContent = '₹0';
                updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
                return;
            }

            const total = cart.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.price, 0);
            totalEl.textContent = `₹${total}`;

            listEl.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800">
                    <div>
                        <div class="font-bold text-sm text-white">${item.name}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-purple-400">Kit Included: ${item.kit}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-emerald-400">₹${item.price}</span>
                        <button type="button" data-remove-id="${item.id}" class="remove-cart-item text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-400 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded bg-slate-900">✕</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            listEl.querySelectorAll('.remove-cart-item').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-remove-id');
                    cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== id);
                    updateCartUI();
                });
            });

            updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
        }

        function openCheckoutModal() {
            if (cart.length === 0) {
                cart.push(RANKS_DATA[0]);
                updateCartUI();
            } else {
                updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
            }
            document.getElementById('order-receipt-box').classList.add('hidden');
            const modal = document.getElementById('checkout-modal');
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            modal.classList.add('flex');
        }

        function closeCheckoutModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('checkout-modal');
            modal.classList.add('hidden');
            modal.classList.remove('flex');
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // SERVER STATUS
        // =========================================================================
        const SERVER_HOST = 'basic.vitalcloud.in';
        const SERVER_PORT = 19153;
        let statusIntervalId = null;

        async function fetchServerStatus() {
            const indicator = document.getElementById('server-status-indicator');
            const badge = document.getElementById('server-status-badge');
            const motdEl = document.getElementById('server-motd-text');
            const onlineTextEl = document.getElementById('hero-online-text');
            const playersCountEl = document.getElementById('hero-players-count');
            const navDot = document.getElementById('nav-status-dot');
            const navPill = document.getElementById('nav-player-pill');
            const refreshIcon = document.getElementById('refresh-status-icon');

            if (refreshIcon) refreshIcon.classList.add('animate-spin');

            const endpoints = [
                `https://api.mcstatus.io/v2/status/java/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
                `https://api.mcsrvstat.us/3/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
                `https://api.mcstatus.io/v2/status/bedrock/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
                `https://api.mcsrvstat.us/bedrock/3/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`
            ];

            let isOnline = false;
            let onlinePlayers = 0;
            let maxPlayers = 0;
            let cleanMotd = '';
            let liveNames = [];

            for (const url of endpoints) {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
                    if (!res.ok) continue;
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data && data.online === true) {
                        isOnline = true;
                        onlinePlayers = (data.players && typeof data.players.online === 'number') ? data.players.online : 0;
                        maxPlayers = (data.players && typeof data.players.max === 'number') ? data.players.max : 100;
                        if (data.players && Array.isArray(data.players.list)) {
                            liveNames = data.players.list.map(p => (typeof p === 'string' ? p : (p.name_clean || p.name || ''))).filter(Boolean);
                        } else if (data.players && Array.isArray(data.players.sample)) {
                            liveNames = data.players.sample.map(p => p.name || '').filter(Boolean);
                        }
                        if (data.motd) {
                            if (typeof data.motd.clean === 'string') {
                                cleanMotd = data.motd.clean.trim();
                            } else if (Array.isArray(data.motd.clean)) {
                                cleanMotd = data.motd.clean.join(' ').trim();
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    } else if (data && data.players && typeof data.players.max === 'number' && maxPlayers === 0) {
                        maxPlayers = data.players.max;
                    }
                } catch (err) {}
            }

            if (refreshIcon) refreshIcon.classList.remove('animate-spin');
            // synced


            if (isOnline) {
                indicator.className = 'w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping shrink-0';
                badge.className = 'px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/40';
                badge.textContent = '● ONLINE';
                onlineTextEl.className = 'font-display font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm sm:text-base mt-0.5';
                onlineTextEl.textContent = 'ONLINE';
                playersCountEl.textContent = `${onlinePlayers} / ${maxPlayers}`;
                motdEl.textContent = cleanMotd || `Connected to ${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT} • Ready to join!`;
                if (navDot) navDot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse';
                if (navPill) {
                    navPill.className = 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-[10px] text-emerald-300 font-bold';
                    navPill.textContent = `${onlinePlayers} Online`;
                }
            } else {
                indicator.className = 'w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 shrink-0';
                badge.className = 'px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-400/40';
                badge.textContent = '○ OFFLINE';
                onlineTextEl.className = 'font-display font-bold text-rose-400 text-sm sm:text-base mt-0.5';
                onlineTextEl.textContent = 'OFFLINE';
                playersCountEl.textContent = `0 / ${maxPlayers || '--'}`;
                motdEl.textContent = `${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT} is currently offline or restarting.`;
                if (navDot) navDot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500';
                if (navPill) {
                    navPill.className = 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/20 text-[10px] text-rose-300 font-bold';
                    navPill.textContent = 'Offline';
                }
            }
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // PLAYER FEEDBACK SYSTEM & PASSWORD PROTECTED DEVELOPER PORTAL
        // =========================================================================
        const DEFAULT_DEV_PASSWORD = 'ghostmc123';

        function getDevPassword() {
            try {
                const stored = localStorage.getItem('ghostmc_dev_password');
                if (stored === 'devesh123' || !stored) {
                    localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_dev_password', DEFAULT_DEV_PASSWORD);
                    return DEFAULT_DEV_PASSWORD;
                }
                return stored;
            } catch (e) {
                return DEFAULT_DEV_PASSWORD;
            }
        }
        const INITIAL_FEEDBACKS = [];

        let devAuthToken = false;
        let selectedStarRating = 5;
        let feedbackList = [];



        function setDevPassword(newPwd) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_dev_password', newPwd);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function loadFeedbacks() {
            try {
                const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ghostmc_feedbacks_data') || 'null');
                if (Array.isArray(saved)) {
                    // Filter out any of the old dummy/fake feedback entries
                    const fakeIds = ['fb_1', 'fb_2', 'fb_3', 'fb_4'];
                    const fakeIgns = ['AaravGamerZ', 'Karan_PvP', 'Rohan_Bedrock', 'ShadowKnight_IN'];
                    feedbackList = saved.filter(f => !fakeIds.includes(f.id) && !fakeIgns.includes(f.ign));
                    // Update localStorage with clean list
                    localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_feedbacks_data', JSON.stringify(feedbackList));
                } else {
                    feedbackList = [];
                }
            } catch (e) {
                feedbackList = [];
            }
            renderDevDashboard();
        }

        function saveFeedbacks() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_feedbacks_data', JSON.stringify(feedbackList));
            } catch (e) {}
            renderDevDashboard();
        }

        function updateStarUI(val) {
            selectedStarRating = val;
            const container = document.getElementById('star-rating-container');
            const label = document.getElementById('star-rating-label');
            const descriptions = {
                1: '1 / 5 (Needs Improvement)',
                2: '2 / 5 (Fair)',
                3: '3 / 5 (Good)',
                4: '4 / 5 (Great SMP!)',
                5: '5 / 5 (Excellent Server!)'
            };
            if (label) label.textContent = descriptions[val] || `${val} / 5`;

            container.querySelectorAll('.star-rating-item').forEach(star => {
                const starVal = parseInt(star.getAttribute('data-val') || '1', 10);
                if (starVal <= val) {
                    star.className = 'star-rating-item text-amber-400 transition-transform hover:scale-125';
                } else {
                    star.className = 'star-rating-item text-slate-600 transition-transform hover:scale-125';
                }
            });
        }

        function renderDevDashboard() {
            if (!devAuthToken) return;

            const totalEl = document.getElementById('stat-total-fb');
            const avgEl = document.getElementById('stat-avg-rating');
            const fiveStarEl = document.getElementById('stat-5star-count');
            const bugsEl = document.getElementById('stat-bugs-count');
            const listEl = document.getElementById('dev-feedbacks-list');

            const total = feedbackList.length;
            const sumRating = feedbackList.reduce((acc, f) => acc + (f.rating || 5), 0);
            const avg = total > 0 ? (sumRating / total).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
            const fiveStars = feedbackList.filter(f => f.rating === 5).length;
            const bugs = feedbackList.filter(f => f.category && f.category.includes('Bug')).length;

            if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = String(total);
            if (avgEl) avgEl.textContent = total > 0 ? `${avg} ★` : '0.0 ★';
            if (fiveStarEl) fiveStarEl.textContent = String(fiveStars);
            if (bugsEl) bugsEl.textContent = String(bugs);

            if (!listEl) return;

            const catFilter = document.getElementById('dev-filter-category').value;
            const ratingFilter = document.getElementById('dev-filter-rating').value;
            const searchKeyword = (document.getElementById('dev-search-fb').value || '').trim().toLowerCase();

            const filtered = feedbackList.filter(f => {
                if (catFilter !== 'all' && f.category !== catFilter) return false;
                if (ratingFilter === '5' && f.rating !== 5) return false;
                if (ratingFilter === '4' && f.rating !== 4) return false;
                if (ratingFilter === '3' && f.rating > 3) return false;
                if (searchKeyword) {
                    const matchIgn = (f.ign || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchKeyword);
                    const matchMsg = (f.message || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchKeyword);
                    if (!matchIgn && !matchMsg) return false;
                }
                return true;
            });

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                const isFiltered = catFilter !== 'all' || ratingFilter !== 'all' || searchKeyword !== '';
                listEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-8 rounded-2xl bg-black/60 border border-slate-800 text-center text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400">
                        ${isFiltered ? 'No feedback matching the selected filters.' : 'Abhi tak koi feedback submit nahi hua hai. Naya feedback submit hone par yahan dikhega.'}
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            listEl.innerHTML = filtered.map(fb => {
                const stars = '★'.repeat(fb.rating || 5) + '☆'.repeat(5 - (fb.rating || 5));
                return `
                <div class="p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950/90 border border-purple-500/30 space-y-2.5 relative">
                    <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-400/40 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm text-purple-300 shrink-0">
                                ${(fb.ign || 'P').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <span class="font-mono font-bold text-sm text-white">${escapeHtml(fb.ign)}</span>
                                <span class="ml-2 text-xs text-amber-400 font-bold">${stars}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span class="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-900/60 border border-purple-500/40 text-purple-200 font-semibold">
                                ${escapeHtml(fb.category)}
                            </span>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">${escapeHtml(fb.timestamp)}</span>
                            <button type="button" data-del-fb-id="${fb.id}" class="delete-fb-btn p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-600/15 hover:bg-rose-600/30 text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-200 transition-colors" title="Delete Feedback">
                                🗑️
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-200 leading-relaxed bg-black/50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 font-sans">
                        ${escapeHtml(fb.message)}
                    </p>
                </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            listEl.querySelectorAll('.delete-fb-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-del-fb-id');
                    feedbackList = feedbackList.filter(f => f.id !== id);
                    saveFeedbacks();
                    showToast('Feedback removed from developer dashboard.');
                });
            });
        }
