                    sub: 'Java & Bedrock Crossplay Ready • Powered by Devesh',
                    gradient: 'from-purple-300 via-pink-400 to-amber-300',
                    isBrand: true
                }
            ];

            function switchGreeting(item, isFast = false) {
                if (isDismissed || !greetingText) return;

                const exitDuration = isFast ? 55 : 120;

                greetingText.classList.remove('greeting-anim-enter');
                greetingText.classList.add('greeting-anim-exit');
                if (subtext) subtext.style.opacity = '0.3';
                if (langBadge) langBadge.style.opacity = '0.4';

                const fadeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (isDismissed) return;
                    greetingText.textContent = item.text;
                    if (item.isBrand) {
                        greetingText.className = 'font-display text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-wider text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r ' + item.gradient + ' neon-text text-center break-words max-w-full leading-none greeting-anim-enter';
                    } else {
                        greetingText.className = 'font-sans text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-wide text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r ' + item.gradient + ' neon-text text-center break-words max-w-full leading-none greeting-anim-enter';
                    }

                    if (langBadge) {
                        langBadge.textContent = item.lang;
                        langBadge.style.opacity = '1';
                    }

                    if (subtext) {
                        subtext.textContent = item.sub;
                        subtext.style.opacity = '1';
                    }
                }, exitDuration);
                activeTimers.push(fadeTimer);
            }

            // Timeline synchronization (Adjusted 5% slower pacing):
            // Slow Phase (0% to 70% in ~11025ms): 24 world languages (~459ms each)
            // Fast Rush Phase (70% to 100% in ~1425ms): 8 world languages (~142ms rapid cascade)
            // Grand Finale (near 100%): GHOSTMC Brand reveal at 12180ms until completion (~12950ms)
            greetingSequence.forEach((item, idx) => {
                let delay = 0;
                let isFast = false;
                if (idx < 24) {
                    delay = Math.round(idx * (11025 / 24));
                } else if (idx < 32) {
                    delay = 11025 + Math.round((idx - 24) * (1155 / 8));
                    isFast = true;
                } else {
                    delay = 12180;
                }
                const timerId = setTimeout(() => {
                    switchGreeting(item, isFast);
                }, delay);
                activeTimers.push(timerId);
            });

            // Dynamic Progress Counter (5% Slower Pace):
            // 0% to 70%: Slow progress at 158ms per 1% (~11.0s)
            // 70% to 100%: Fast rush at 47ms per 1% (~1.41s) -> Over 3.3x faster after 70%!
            let progress = 0;
            let canSkip = false;

            function scheduleProgressTick() {
                if (isDismissed) return;
                
                // Slow from 0% up to 70% (158ms), then fast from 70% to 100% (47ms) - 5% slower overall
                const tickDelay = progress < 70 ? 158 : 47;
                
                const timerId = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (isDismissed) return;
                    progress = Math.min(progress + 1, 100);
                    if (percentEl) percentEl.textContent = progress + '%';

                    if (progress >= 10 && !canSkip) {
                        canSkip = true;
                        loader.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                    }

                    if (progress < 100) {
                        scheduleProgressTick();
                    } else {
                        // Complete at 100% -> Auto dismiss smoothly after 500ms
                        const finishTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                            dismissLoader();
                        }, 500);
                        activeTimers.push(finishTimer);
                    }
                }, tickDelay);
                activeTimers.push(timerId);
            }

            scheduleProgressTick();

            // 10% Click-to-Skip Logic (No intrusive note/toast displayed)
            loader.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (isDismissed) return;
                if (progress >= 10) {
                    dismissLoader();
                }
            });
        }

        
        // =========================================================================
        // DESKTOP / MOBILE VIEW MODE SWITCHER (Top-Left Corner Option)
        // =========================================================================
        function initViewModeSwitcher() {
            const desktopBtn = document.getElementById('view-desktop-btn');
            const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('view-mobile-btn');
            const loaderDesktopBtn = document.getElementById('loader-view-desktop-btn');
            const loaderMobileBtn = document.getElementById('loader-view-mobile-btn');
            const loaderLabelDesktop = document.getElementById('loader-label-desktop');
            const loaderLabelMobile = document.getElementById('loader-label-mobile');
            const loaderContainer = document.getElementById('loader-view-mode-container');

            if (loaderContainer) {
                loaderContainer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                });
            }

            function applyViewMode(mode, showNotification) {
                document.body.setAttribute('data-view-mode', mode);
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_view_mode', mode);
                } catch (e) {}

                if (mode === 'desktop') {
                    if (desktopBtn) {
                        desktopBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn active px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-sm';
                    }
                    if (mobileBtn) {
                        mobileBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white';
                    }
                    if (loaderDesktopBtn) {
                        loaderDesktopBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn active px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-md cursor-pointer';
                    }
                    if (loaderMobileBtn) {
                        loaderMobileBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-purple-500/30 text-slate-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer';
                    }
                    if (loaderLabelDesktop) {
                        loaderLabelDesktop.className = 'text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-300';
                    }
                    if (loaderLabelMobile) {
                        loaderLabelMobile.className = 'text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400';
                    }
                    if (showNotification) {
                        showToast('🖥️ Desktop View Mode Selected (Original Size)');
                    }
                } else {
                    if (mobileBtn) {
                        mobileBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn active px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-sm';
                    }
                    if (desktopBtn) {
                        desktopBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white';
                    }
                    if (loaderMobileBtn) {
                        loaderMobileBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn active px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-md cursor-pointer';
                    }
                    if (loaderDesktopBtn) {
                        loaderDesktopBtn.className = 'view-toggle-btn px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-purple-500/30 text-slate-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer';
                    }
                    if (loaderLabelMobile) {
                        loaderLabelMobile.className = 'text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-300';
                    }
                    if (loaderLabelDesktop) {
                        loaderLabelDesktop.className = 'text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400';
                    }
                    if (showNotification) {
                        showToast('📱 Mobile View Mode Selected');
                    }
                }
            }

            if (desktopBtn) {
                desktopBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    applyViewMode('desktop', true);
                });
            }
            if (mobileBtn) {
                mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    applyViewMode('mobile', true);
                });
            }
            if (loaderDesktopBtn) {
                loaderDesktopBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    applyViewMode('desktop', true);
                });
            }
            if (loaderMobileBtn) {
                loaderMobileBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    applyViewMode('mobile', true);
                });
            }

            // Default to 'desktop' (purana wala size) or user saved preference
            let savedMode = 'desktop';
            try {
                savedMode = localStorage.getItem('ghostmc_view_mode') || 'desktop';
            } catch (e) {
                savedMode = 'desktop';
            }
            applyViewMode(savedMode, false);
        }

        // Site Refresh Trigger
        function triggerSiteRefresh(btn) {
            showToast('🔄 Refreshing GhostMC SMP Website & Live Status...');
            const icon = btn ? btn.querySelector('.refresh-icon') : null;
            if (icon) icon.classList.add('animate-spin');
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.reload();
            }, 600);
        }

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initViewModeSwitcher();
            initCyberLoader();
            document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'phantom');

            // Top Site Refresh Button Bindings
            const siteRefreshBtn = document.getElementById('site-refresh-btn');
            if (siteRefreshBtn) {
                siteRefreshBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerSiteRefresh(siteRefreshBtn));
            }
            const mobileSiteRefreshBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-site-refresh-btn');
            if (mobileSiteRefreshBtn) {
                mobileSiteRefreshBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerSiteRefresh(mobileSiteRefreshBtn));
            }

            // Mobile Navigation Toggle
            const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-btn');
            const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
            const hamburgerIcon = document.getElementById('hamburger-icon');
            const closeMenuIcon = document.getElementById('close-menu-icon');

            if (mobileMenuBtn && mobileMenu) {
                mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const isHidden = mobileMenu.classList.contains('hidden');
                    if (isHidden) {
                        mobileMenu.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (hamburgerIcon) hamburgerIcon.classList.add('hidden');
                        if (closeMenuIcon) closeMenuIcon.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden');
                        if (hamburgerIcon) hamburgerIcon.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (closeMenuIcon) closeMenuIcon.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                });

                document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => {
                    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden');
                        if (hamburgerIcon) hamburgerIcon.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (closeMenuIcon) closeMenuIcon.classList.add('hidden');
                    });
                });

                const mobileCopyIpBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-copy-ip-btn');
                if (mobileCopyIpBtn) {
                    mobileCopyIpBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        copyToClipboard('basic.vitalcloud.in:19153', 'Server IP & Port');
                        mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden');
                        if (hamburgerIcon) hamburgerIcon.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (closeMenuIcon) closeMenuIcon.classList.add('hidden');
                    });
                }
            }

            // visitor counter removed
            // joined players removed
            loadFeedbacks();
            renderRanks();
            fetchServerStatus();

            if (statusIntervalId) clearInterval(statusIntervalId);
            statusIntervalId = setInterval(fetchServerStatus, 60000);

            // Tab Switchers: Public Feedback Form vs Developer Portal
            const tabGiveFbBtn = document.getElementById('tab-give-feedback-btn');
            const tabDevPortalBtn = document.getElementById('tab-dev-portal-btn');
            const formView = document.getElementById('feedback-form-view');
            const devView = document.getElementById('dev-portal-view');
            const devAuthBox = document.getElementById('dev-auth-box');
            const devDashboardBox = document.getElementById('dev-dashboard-box');
            const switchToDevLink = document.getElementById('switch-to-dev-link');

            function showGiveFeedbackTab() {
                formView.classList.remove('hidden');
                devView.classList.add('hidden');
                tabGiveFbBtn.className = 'px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                tabDevPortalBtn.className = 'px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
            }

            function showDevPortalTab() {
                formView.classList.add('hidden');
                devView.classList.remove('hidden');
                tabDevPortalBtn.className = 'px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                tabGiveFbBtn.className = 'px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center gap-2';

                if (devAuthToken) {
                    devAuthBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    devDashboardBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    renderDevDashboard();
                } else {
                    devAuthBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    devDashboardBox.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            tabGiveFbBtn.addEventListener('click', showGiveFeedbackTab);
            tabDevPortalBtn.addEventListener('click', showDevPortalTab);
            if (switchToDevLink) {
                switchToDevLink.addEventListener('click', showDevPortalTab);
            }

            // Star Rating Click
            document.querySelectorAll('.star-rating-item').forEach(star => {
                star.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const val = parseInt(star.getAttribute('data-val') || '5', 10);
                    updateStarUI(val);
                });
            });

            // Feedback Character Count
            const msgInput = document.getElementById('fb-message');
            const charCountEl = document.getElementById('fb-char-count');
            if (msgInput && charCountEl) {
                msgInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    charCountEl.textContent = `${msgInput.value.length} / 500 characters`;
                });
            }

            // Public Feedback Form Submit
            const fbForm = document.getElementById('public-feedback-form');
            if (fbForm) {
                fbForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const ign = document.getElementById('fb-player-name').value.trim();
                    const category = document.getElementById('fb-category').value;
                    const message = document.getElementById('fb-message').value.trim();

                    if (!ign || !message) {
                        showToast('Please fill in both your IGN and feedback message!');
                        return;
                    }

                    const now = new Date();
                    const formattedTime = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) + ', ' +
                        now.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

                    const newFeedback = {
                        id: 'fb_' + Date.now(),
                        ign,
                        rating: selectedStarRating,
                        category,
                        message,
                        timestamp: formattedTime
                    };

                    feedbackList.unshift(newFeedback);
                    saveFeedbacks();

                    fbForm.reset();
                    updateStarUI(5);
                    if (charCountEl) charCountEl.textContent = '0 / 500 characters';

                    showToast(`Thank you ${ign}! Your feedback has been submitted to Owner Devesh.`);
                });
            }

            // Developer Login (Password Verification)
            const devUnlockBtn = document.getElementById('dev-unlock-btn');
            const devPasswordInput = document.getElementById('dev-password-input');
            const devAuthError = document.getElementById('dev-auth-error');
            const lockBadge = document.getElementById('dev-portal-lock-badge');

            const devAuthSuccess = document.getElementById('dev-auth-success');

            function handleDevLogin() {
                const entered = (devPasswordInput.value || '').trim();
                const actual = getDevPassword();

                if (!entered) {
                    devAuthError.classList.remove('hidden');
                    devPasswordInput.classList.add('animate-shake', 'border-rose-500');
                    setTimeout(() => devPasswordInput.classList.remove('animate-shake'), 500);
                    showToast('Please enter the developer password.');
                    return;
                }

                if (entered === actual) {
                    // Sahi Password Animation
                    devAuthError.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (devAuthSuccess) devAuthSuccess.classList.remove('hidden');
                    devPasswordInput.classList.remove('border-rose-500', 'ring-rose-500/50');
                    devPasswordInput.classList.add('border-emerald-400', 'ring-2', 'ring-emerald-400/50', 'text-emerald-300');

                    const lockIcon = document.getElementById('dev-auth-lock-icon');
                    if (lockIcon) lockIcon.textContent = '🔓';
                    const iconWrap = document.getElementById('dev-auth-icon-wrap');
                    if (iconWrap) {
                        iconWrap.className = 'w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/60 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl mx-auto shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30 scale-110 transition-all duration-300';
                    }

                    devUnlockBtn.disabled = true;
                    devUnlockBtn.innerHTML = `
                        <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-300 animate-ping"></span>
                            <span>✅ Verified! Unlocking Dashboard...</span>
                        </span>
                    `;
                    devUnlockBtn.className = 'w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold text-sm shadow-xl shadow-emerald-500/25 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2';

                    showToast('✅ Password Sahi Hai! Developer Control Center Unlocked.');

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        devAuthToken = true;
                        devPasswordInput.value = '';
                        devPasswordInput.classList.remove('border-emerald-400', 'ring-2', 'ring-emerald-400/50', 'text-emerald-300');
                        if (devAuthSuccess) devAuthSuccess.classList.add('hidden');
                        devUnlockBtn.disabled = false;
                        devUnlockBtn.innerHTML = '<span>🔓 Unlock Developer Portal</span>';
                        devUnlockBtn.className = 'w-full py-3 rounded-xl theme-btn-primary font-bold text-sm shadow-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2';
                        if (lockIcon) lockIcon.textContent = '🔐';
                        if (iconWrap) {
                            iconWrap.className = 'w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-400/40 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl mx-auto shadow-inner transition-all duration-300';
                        }

                        devAuthBox.classList.add('hidden');
                        devDashboardBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                        devDashboardBox.classList.add('animate-fadeInUp');
                        if (lockBadge) {
                            lockBadge.textContent = 'Unlocked';
                            lockBadge.className = 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40';
                        }
                        renderDevDashboard();
                    }, 750);
                } else {
                    // Incorrect Password Error & Shake Animation (English)
                    if (devAuthSuccess) devAuthSuccess.classList.add('hidden');
                    devAuthError.classList.remove('hidden');
                    devPasswordInput.classList.add('animate-shake', 'border-rose-500', 'ring-2', 'ring-rose-500/40');
                    devPasswordInput.focus();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        devPasswordInput.classList.remove('animate-shake');
                    }, 500);
                    showToast('❌ Incorrect password! Access denied.');
                }
            }

            if (devUnlockBtn) devUnlockBtn.addEventListener('click', handleDevLogin);
            if (devPasswordInput) {
                devPasswordInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') handleDevLogin();
                });
            }

            // Toggle Password Visibility
            const togglePwdBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-pwd-vis-btn');
            if (togglePwdBtn && devPasswordInput) {
                togglePwdBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    devPasswordInput.type = devPasswordInput.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
                });
            }

            // Lock / Logout Developer Portal
            const devLockBtn = document.getElementById('dev-lock-btn');
            if (devLockBtn) {
                devLockBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    devAuthToken = false;
                    devAuthBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    devDashboardBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (lockBadge) {
                        lockBadge.textContent = 'Locked';
                        lockBadge.className = 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-purple-950 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40';
                    }
                    showToast('Developer portal locked.');
                });
            }

            // Change Developer Password (requires 6-digit security code: 672345)
            const changePwdBtn = document.getElementById('change-pwd-btn');
            const changePwdBox = document.getElementById('change-pwd-box');
            const saveNewPwdBtn = document.getElementById('save-new-pwd-btn');
            const cancelNewPwdBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-new-pwd-btn');
            const newDevPwdInput = document.getElementById('new-dev-pwd-input');
            const devSecurityCodeInput = document.getElementById('dev-security-code-input');

            if (changePwdBtn && changePwdBox) {
                changePwdBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    changePwdBox.classList.toggle('hidden');
                    if (!changePwdBox.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                        if (devSecurityCodeInput) {
                            devSecurityCodeInput.value = '';
                            devSecurityCodeInput.focus();
                        }
                        if (newDevPwdInput) newDevPwdInput.value = '';
                    }
                });
            }
            if (cancelNewPwdBtn && changePwdBox) {
                cancelNewPwdBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    changePwdBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (devSecurityCodeInput) devSecurityCodeInput.value = '';
                    if (newDevPwdInput) newDevPwdInput.value = '';
                });
            }
            if (saveNewPwdBtn) {
                saveNewPwdBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const secCode = (devSecurityCodeInput ? devSecurityCodeInput.value : '').trim();
                    const newPwd = (newDevPwdInput ? newDevPwdInput.value : '').trim();

                    // Security verification: exact 6-digit code required
                    if (secCode !== '672345') {
                        if (devSecurityCodeInput) {
                            devSecurityCodeInput.classList.add('animate-shake', 'border-rose-500', 'ring-2', 'ring-rose-500/40');
                            devSecurityCodeInput.focus();
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                devSecurityCodeInput.classList.remove('animate-shake');
                            }, 500);
                        }
                        showToast('❌ Invalid 6-digit security code! Access denied.');
                        return;
                    }

                    if (newPwd.length < 4) {
                        if (newDevPwdInput) {
                            newDevPwdInput.classList.add('animate-shake', 'border-rose-500', 'ring-2', 'ring-rose-500/40');
                            newDevPwdInput.focus();
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                newDevPwdInput.classList.remove('animate-shake');
                            }, 500);
                        }
                        showToast('Password must be at least 4 characters long.');
                        return;
                    }

                    setDevPassword(newPwd);
                    showToast('✅ Developer password updated successfully!');
                    changePwdBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (devSecurityCodeInput) devSecurityCodeInput.value = '';
                    if (newDevPwdInput) newDevPwdInput.value = '';
                });
            }

            // Export / Copy All Feedbacks
            const exportFbBtn = document.getElementById('export-feedbacks-btn');
            if (exportFbBtn) {

                        showToast('No feedbacks to copy.');

                    const text = feedbackList.map((f, i) =>
                        `[${i + 1}] Player: ${f.ign} (${f.rating}★) - ${f.category}
Date: ${f.timestamp}
Feedback: ${f.message}`
                    ).join(String.fromCharCode(10) + '---' + String.fromCharCode(10, 10));
                    copyToClipboard(text, 'All Player Feedbacks');
                });
            }

            // Clear All Feedbacks (two-click confirmation without blocked confirm dialog)
            const clearAllFbBtn = document.getElementById('clear-all-fb-btn');
            let clearAllConfirmPending = false;
            let clearAllTimer = null;
            if (clearAllFbBtn) {
                clearAllFbBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (!clearAllConfirmPending) {
                        clearAllConfirmPending = true;
                        clearAllFbBtn.textContent = 'Confirm Clear All?';
                        clearAllFbBtn.classList.add('bg-red-700', 'text-white');
                        clearAllTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                            clearAllConfirmPending = false;
                            clearAllFbBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"/></svg><span>Clear All</span>`;
                            clearAllFbBtn.classList.remove('bg-red-700', 'text-white');
                        }, 4000);
                        return;
                    }
                    clearTimeout(clearAllTimer);
                    clearAllConfirmPending = false;
                    clearAllFbBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"/></svg><span>Clear All</span>`;
                    clearAllFbBtn.classList.remove('bg-red-700', 'text-white');
                    feedbackList = [];
                    saveFeedbacks();
                    showToast('All feedbacks cleared.');
                });
            }

            // Developer Filter listeners
            document.getElementById('dev-filter-category').addEventListener('change', renderDevDashboard);
            document.getElementById('dev-filter-rating').addEventListener('change', renderDevDashboard);
            document.getElementById('dev-search-fb').addEventListener('input', renderDevDashboard);

            document.getElementById('refresh-status-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                fetchServerStatus();
                showToast('Refreshing GhostMC server status...');
            });

            // Copy triggers
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-trigger').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    copyToClipboard(btn.getAttribute('data-copy'), btn.getAttribute('data-label'));
                });
            });

            document.getElementById('nav-copy-ip-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                copyToClipboard('basic.vitalcloud.in:19153', 'Server IP & Port');
            });

            document.getElementById('hero-copy-all-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                copyToClipboard('basic.vitalcloud.in:19153', 'Server IP & Port');
            });

            document.getElementById('modal-copy-upi-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                copyToClipboard(MERCHANT_UPI, 'UPI ID');
            });

            document.getElementById('mc-username').addEventListener('input', () => {
                updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
            });

            document.getElementById('direct-upi-pay-link').addEventListener('click', () => {
                const total = cart.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.price, 0);
                copyToClipboard(MERCHANT_UPI, 'UPI ID');
                showToast(`Opening UPI App for ₹${total} to ${MERCHANT_UPI}...`);
            });

            // Filter buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.rank-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    activeFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.rank-filter-btn').forEach(b => {
                        b.className = 'rank-filter-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 border border-slate-800 hover:border-purple-500/40 transition-all';
                    });
                    btn.className = 'rank-filter-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-purple-500 text-white transition-all';
                    renderRanks();
                });
            });

            // Modal controls
            document.getElementById('open-cart-btn').addEventListener('click', openCheckoutModal);
            document.getElementById('close-modal-btn').addEventListener('click', closeCheckoutModal);
            document.getElementById('checkout-modal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (e.target.id === 'checkout-modal') closeCheckoutModal();
            });

            // Payment method selection
            document.querySelectorAll('.pay-method-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    selectedPayment = btn.getAttribute('data-pay');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.pay-method-btn').forEach(b => {
                        b.className = 'pay-method-btn p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-300 transition-all';
                    });
                    btn.className = 'pay-method-btn p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-all';
                    updateUpiPaymentWidgets();

                const total = cart.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.price, 0);

                box.classList.remove('hidden');
                copyToClipboard(receipt, 'Order Ticket');
            
        // ==========================================
        // RETRO-FUTURISTIC WEB AUDIO SYNTHESIZER
        // ==========================================
        let sfxEnabled = true;
        let audioCtx = null;

        function getAudioContext() {
            if (!audioCtx) {
                const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                if (AudioContextClass) {
                    audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
                }
            }
            if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
                audioCtx.resume();
            }
            return audioCtx;
        }

        function playCyberSound(type) {
            if (!sfxEnabled) return;
            try {
                const ctx = getAudioContext();
                if (!ctx) return;
                const now = ctx.currentTime;

                if (type === 'click') {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, now);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(440, now + 0.05);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, now);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.05);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.05);
                } else if (type === 'copy') {
                    // Cheerful two-tone chime
                    [587.33, 880].forEach((freq, i) => {
                        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                        const gain = ctx.createGain();
                        osc.type = 'triangle';
                        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + i * 0.07);
                        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, now + i * 0.07);
                        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.07 + 0.12);
                        osc.connect(gain);
                        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                        osc.start(now + i * 0.07);
                        osc.stop(now + i * 0.07 + 0.13);
                    });
                } else if (type === 'warp') {
                    // Modal warp sweep
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, now);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(960, now + 0.15);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, now);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.16);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.16);
                } else if (type === 'switch') {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(520, now);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, now);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.04);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.04);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Audio synth error:', e);
            }
        }

        // SFX Toggle Event Listener
        const sfxBtn = document.getElementById('sfx-toggle-btn');
        if (sfxBtn) {
            sfxBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                sfxEnabled = !sfxEnabled;
                const icon = document.getElementById('sfx-icon');
                const text = document.getElementById('sfx-text');
                if (sfxEnabled) {
                    if (icon) icon.textContent = '🔊';
                    if (text) text.textContent = 'SFX ON';
                    sfxBtn.classList.remove('opacity-60');
                    sfxBtn.title = 'Sound Effects: ON';
                    playCyberSound('copy');
                    showToast('Cyber Sound Effects Enabled');
                } else {
                    if (icon) icon.textContent = '🔇';
                    if (text) text.textContent = 'SFX OFF';
                    sfxBtn.classList.add('opacity-60');
                    sfxBtn.title = 'Sound Effects: OFF';
                    showToast('Sound Effects Muted');
                }
            });
        }

        // How-To-Join Tabs Logic
        const tabJava = document.getElementById('join-tab-java');
        const tabBedrock = document.getElementById('join-tab-bedrock');
        const tabConsole = document.getElementById('join-tab-console');
        const panelJava = document.getElementById('join-panel-java');
        const panelBedrock = document.getElementById('join-panel-bedrock');
        const panelConsole = document.getElementById('join-panel-console');

        function switchJoinTab(activeTab, activePanel) {
            playCyberSound('switch');
            [tabJava, tabBedrock, tabConsole].forEach(t => {
                if (t) {
                    t.classList.remove('active', 'text-white', 'bg-gradient-to-r', 'from-cyan-500', 'to-purple-600', 'shadow-lg', 'shadow-cyan-500/25');
                    t.classList.add('text-slate-400');
                }
            });
            [panelJava, panelBedrock, panelConsole].forEach(p => {
                if (p) p.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            if (activeTab) {
                activeTab.classList.add('active', 'text-white', 'bg-gradient-to-r', 'from-cyan-500', 'to-purple-600', 'shadow-lg', 'shadow-cyan-500/25');
                activeTab.classList.remove('text-slate-400');
            }
            if (activePanel) {
                activePanel.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        if (tabJava && panelJava) tabJava.addEventListener('click', () => switchJoinTab(tabJava, panelJava));
        if (tabBedrock && panelBedrock) tabBedrock.addEventListener('click', () => switchJoinTab(tabBedrock, panelBedrock));
        if (tabConsole && panelConsole) tabConsole.addEventListener('click', () => switchJoinTab(tabConsole, panelConsole));

        // Quick Copy buttons inside How-To-Join
        document.querySelectorAll('.copy-java-ip-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => copyToClipboard('basic.vitalcloud.in:19153', 'Java Address'));
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('.copy-bedrock-ip-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => copyToClipboard('basic.vitalcloud.in', 'Bedrock Address'));
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('.copy-bedrock-port-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => copyToClipboard('19153', 'Bedrock Port'));
        });

        // FAQ Accordion Logic
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                playCyberSound('click');
                const answer = btn.nextElementSibling;
                const chevron = btn.querySelector('.faq-chevron');
                if (answer) {
                    const isHidden = answer.classList.contains('hidden');
                    // Close all answers
                    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-answer').forEach(a => a.classList.add('hidden'));
                    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-chevron').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('rotate-180'));

                    if (isHidden) {
                        answer.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (chevron) chevron.classList.add('rotate-180');
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
